latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video CapCut.

- Convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos.
- Cloud GPU processing delivers quick video creation (30–60 seconds for typical jobs).
- Simple authentication flow with 100 free credits for new users.
- Automatically matches user requests to editing, upload, export, and credits actions.
- Exports optimized, shareable videos for TikTok and other platforms.
- Clear error handling and guidance for supported files, credits, and account setup.
